title: Views over RLS tables run with the view owner's RLS status (correctness)
issue: A view's base tables are read with the view owner's privileges. Owner = superuser / BYPASSRLS / table owner without FORCE means policies are skipped; security_invoker = true (PG15+) fixes it.
symptom: Row counts through owner-owned views equal the whole table instead of the subject's rows. Variants whose counts differ from no_rls_baseline leak other tenants' rows through the view.

scale.meaning: number of rows in app.docs (10 orgs; user N is a member of org N only)
